question: As per the guidelines of the Reserve Bank of India, from 1 August 2025, the trading hours of market repo and Tri-Party Repo (TREP) were extended till what time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sat Dec 30 1899 16:00:00 GMT+0521 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, starting from **1 August 2025**, the trading hours for market repo and Tri-Party Repo (TREP) markets were extended till **4:00 PM IST**.
 
• The move is aimed at enhancing the **liquidity and efficiency** in the financial markets by allowing more time for participants to execute trades.
 
• A **market repo** is a short-term borrowing tool where one party sells securities to another with an agreement to repurchase them at a predetermined price and date.
 
• **Tri-Party Repo (TREP)** is a similar mechanism involving a third-party agent for collateral management, which ensures reduced settlement risks.
 
• The extension aligns with RBI's broader objective of **deepening financial markets** and encouraging more participation from stakeholders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Market Repo:**

 
 
• This is a tool for **short-term borrowing and lending** in the money market.
 
• It involves selling securities with an agreement to repurchase them at a later date.
 
• It is used by **banks, financial institutions**, and other participants to manage liquidity needs.
 
 
 
• **Tri-Party Repo (TREP):**
 
 
• Involves a **third-party agent** (usually a clearing corporation) to manage collateral.
 
• It reduces **settlement and counterparty risks**.
 
• TREP is widely used in India for short-term borrowing and lending in the money market.
 
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**
 
 
• The central bank of India, established on **1 April 1935**, headquartered in Mumbai.
 
• RBI regulates the monetary policy and ensures the **stability of the financial system**.
 
• It also oversees the functioning of payment systems and manages India's foreign exchange.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Extended Trading Hours:**
 
 
• Provides market participants with additional time to **complete transactions**.
 
• Enhances **liquidity** and allows better price discovery in the financial markets.
 
• Encourages more participation from investors, traders, and other stakeholders.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **RBI’s Role in Financial Markets:**

 
 
• RBI regulates the **money, foreign exchange, and government securities markets**.
 
• It ensures smooth market operations and facilitates the development of financial infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Repo Transactions:**
 
 
• Repo rate is the **rate at which RBI lends to commercial banks**.
 
• It is a critical tool for implementing **monetary policy**.
